activity_summary: Pope told you your name is not on tomorrow's Shrew. Heminges told you the Rose has the first part of Hercules at two. You said you would go over.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he would cross for Hercules.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Reported that the Shrew plot has no Shakespeare on it.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named the Rose bill once, and did not send him.

facets.activity: Heard Hercules is at the Rose and chose to go

quotes.speaker: thomas_pope
quotes.text: You are out of the Shrew tomorrow.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: The bill at the Rose is the first part of Hercules, at two.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Hercules at two. I am not in the Shrew.
